title: Exact ordered two-/three-block valley maps empty a surviving (L,o) in E_run(10^6)
statement: A finance-surviving CycleMin itinerary, in particular L=25781 or L=55293, must contain an ordered excursion transition (v,a) -> (w,b) that the exact floor cells forbid, so the leftover pair dies without enumerating complete words.
counterexamples: Unscaled pairs (1,1), (2,1), (2,2), (2,3), (3,1) are realized below 20000. (2,2,2) occurs 36 times in [10^6+1, 10^6+20001). (2,2,1) is CycleMin-legal 36 times at scale n^{9/8}
The two-block exact landing at v=1000057 is 39244721 against envelope 39244728 (relative deficit 1.8e-7). Floor loss does not constrain the next run beyond w^8 <= v^9 and 81/64 < 4/3
Prefix (2,2,2) has fourth run 2 at 365 and 1 at 1517. Both fourth valleys sit above oe_start. The scale law does not force a leftover death

Retaining the exact landings 4447 and 33811 does not create a region C_{a,b}. After three OOE both sit in [n^{4/3}, n^{3/2}) just below n^{729/512}, with next runs 2 and 1. In a radius-400 window around each, nearby a=2 starts realize next runs including 1 and 2
Two-block sign F_b(F_a(v)) ? v matches sign(mu(a)mu(b)-1) with 0 flips on [3, 5000) and [10^6+1, 10^6+4002). No compensation: a drop does not force a large next run
mathematical_domain: Juggler cycle finance / ordered excursion maps
notes: The two-block persistence (2,2,1) at v=n is the composed OOE envelope, not a leftover-killer. Reopen 2026-08-31: retaining the exact valley (4447 versus 33811) still yields no C_{a,b} and no two-block sign beyond mu(a)mu(b). No second leftover-killer. No Paper A edit, no ledger row, no Lean. Not a halt theorem.
tested_range: L=25781 and L=55293; first a=2 start 1000057; pair census [10^6+1, 10^6+20001) and n^{9/8} window of width 8000; controls 365, 1517, 501, 6187; local B_2 windows of radius 400 around 4447 and 33811; two-block sign census [3, 5000) and [10^6+1, 10^6+4002)
